---
title: "Viewing my Data"
---
```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
data("penguins")
```

There are many different ways of viewing a data set
```{r}
data("penguins") #loading the penguins data set
```
\
glimpse() shows all of the variables and their R variable type
```{r}
glimpse(penguins)
```
